thread:
elaine: heads-up — dashboards in prod are seeing big frame drops on sparkframe panels since ~09:10 UTC. heatmap/series paints jumping to 400-700ms. :boom:

matt: ugh. did something land on the client today? any canaries?

elaine: small canary for telemetry-client v2 at 09:05. i rolled it to 10% for eu and 0% elsewhere. noticed bundle size increase ~+170kb gz and parse time bump in trace.

sasha: KV cache hits look okay from the surface, but prefetched chunk parse spikes line up with the slow frames. can you paste the devtools CPU flame?

elaine: pasted minimal snapshot:```
MainThread > parse (240ms) > eval (120ms) > render (80ms)
  - telemetry-client.init (heavy)
  - lazy-load: sparkframe.worker (delayed)
```

jorge: fwiw i changed routing weight for eu-canary at 08:58 to favor new edge nodes. that increases cold-route traffic to eu workers — could explain cold parses.

priya: telemetry-client v2 bundles a tiny intl polyfill and moves some sampling setup to sync init. intended to reduce lost events but it is sync. we can make init async but need to ensure no data loss.

matt: async init sounds safer for UX. what if we fallback to queued sampling until init is ready? queue approach used in old client.

elaine: agreed — queueing is fine. immediate ask: can we quick-toggle eu canary back to 0% to see if slowness melts?

jorge: will rollback routing weight in 2m. deploying now. :arrows_counterclockwise:

ci-bot: deploy job #4721 triggered by jorge — routing change applied to envoy cluster eu-edge-1.

matt: also let's add a temporary client override to bypass telemetry-client sync polyfills for dashboard route: add header `x-rw-disable-telemetry-v2` and have client skip intl polyfill if present. low-risk hotfix.

priya: can do. i'll open a tiny PR to gate the sync block behind the header. will include a note about sample preservation and fallback.

elaine: rolling monitor — after routing rollback i still see some tail spikes but median improves. looks like a mix of cold parses + parse-time allocation.

sasha: follow-up: add a short-lived perf metric to console telemetry: `dashboard.parse.block_ms` so we can quantify, then remove after rollback. we can also correlate with `route.affinity` to see if routing weight was the main factor.

priya: PR opened: rw/telemetry#189 — header gate + make intl polyfill lazy via dynamic import. test in canary only.

jorge: posting canary back to 10% after PR lands and monitor. prefer small steps.

elaine: thanks — once PR is up i'll run an A/B with chart workload and measure 95p. if patch works we ship and plan a proper async init for v2.

matt: long-term note: let's avoid sync runtime work in client bootstrap. put critical sampling path behind a microtask queue if possible.

elaine: +1. also let's review bundling: remove duplicated intl helpers across libs (i saw 2 copies). that can shave ~60kb.

priya: added a TODO in the PR for dedupe.

ci-bot: monitor alert resolved at 09:17 UTC — median frame time back to baseline.

elaine: closing for now. follow-ups: (1) telemetry PR to land, (2) bundling dedupe ticket, (3) verify kvcache miss rate. i'll file tickets. :white_check_mark:
